pirs.summary: Storm outages ongoing; BYOD ransomware posture; CISA KEV adds incl. Danfoss building/refrigeration controllers (check inventory); MetroLink CWE single-tracking 30 Nov-5 Dec evenings.

pirs.summary: No Ring 1 event over 5,000. Student return Sat-Sun, classes resume Mon 30 Nov. Stacked: Fri 27, Sat 28, Wed 2. Barnes Lodge fencing early Dec; 6200 Forsyth now opens early 2027.

pirs.name: Policy, legal, funding
pirs.summary: Federal funding lapses after 11 Dec with no deal; DHS bill among hardest. FEMA restructuring pending. Missouri prefiling opens 1 Dec. No Clery/Title IX or confirmed travel-advisory changes.
